name: Saman Bandara, Ph.D.
expertise: Agricultural economics; agribusiness; natural resource economics; economic development
bio: Dr. Saman Bandara is an Associate Professor at West Virginia State University and a Co-Coordinator and Co-Initiator of ERS–WVSU. His interests include agricultural economics, agribusiness, natural resource economics, and regional development. The role reflects involvement in the initiative, not a past ERS–WVSU presentation.
